steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each stakeholder is placed by its influence rating and whether a high-influence one has an owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: High-influence stakeholder with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner for the engagement

findings.title: Concern with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the concern

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] stake-staff.md:12  High-influence stakeholder with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner for the engagement.
[medium] stake-union.md:19  Stakeholder with no influence rating.
       Fix: Rate the influence.
[low] concerns.md:26  Concern with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the concern.
Not checked: Views not in the notes.
pros: Checks a stakeholder with no influence rating, a concern with no source, and a high-influence stakeholder with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Views not in the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-stakeholder-map skill on the records for this review.
